title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida and Carlos Maria Zarate in the Florianopolis, originally scheduled for November 23, 2026 at 8:00AM ET.
This market will resolve to “Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida” if Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida wins the first set. It will resolve to “Carlos Maria Zarate” if Carlos Maria Zarate wins the first set.
If the match begins but is not completed, and the first set is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on that completed set. If the first set is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the match is canceled (not played at all) or play has not begun by December 7, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger match statistics.

This market may resolve only when the listed period of play has concluded and the result can be definitively determined by the listed resolution source(s).
